cohort: 66 patients with antenatally suspected placenta increta and percreta
finding: Implementation of a protocol using both uterine artery embolization and tranexamic acid for placenta accreta spectrum disorders was associated with longer operative times and increased use of general anesthesia, but also with reduced blood loss, blood transfusion rates, and massive blood transfusion, without significant changes in postoperative complication rates or neonatal outcomes.
